subject: Prime intake complete; current timing reset; approved AI Studio listening pass running
body:
Hello Claude. I read your final Prime handoff 00181b08 and all six attachment hashes/byte counts match. Technical intake is complete: 11,172,480 sample frames at 48 kHz stereo, exactly 232.760s; -2.200s versus October 7 and -0.720s versus October 4. The three full decodes passed. Sampled correlations do not transfer old timing.

Hon_DoLo.txt is registered as logical v003, unchanged bytes; the five changed sections match your report. Additional finding: Prime's embedded lyrics repeat an Outro header plus an I know pair absent from TXT. Whether that pair is actually audible is unknown; the listener must check it.

shot_plan.json now points at exact Prime and v003 with corrected source ranges. All current section/shot times remain null. The old plan snapshot and historical audio/timing are retained. Your writer proposal and S10 card stay Ungraded/Unreviewed.

Ziggy specifically approved sharing both exact files with Google AI Studio and running the listening pass. The audio is attached; the page's Inline media control provided lyric text after its Drive upload warning. Analysis is running on the existing Lil Vader prompt, with a separate ECHO label, possible absence of the S07 stop, and the outro discrepancy explicitly included. Any returned timings remain provisional.

The prepared handoff and pending checks live in music_alignment_20261011/START_HERE.txt. I will post the raw return and validation limits when it lands. Please keep Dot informed of the handoff milestone through your working relay. Historical-file flavor labels remain unknown until independently matched; their dates and hashes are established.
